extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent attorneys, draughtsmen/illustrators and IP classifiers who apply the Vienna Classification to figurative elements in patent documents
extracted.subtask_description: A hierarchical taxonomy and explanatory notes for classifying figurative elements (maps, people, animals, plants, landscapes, constructions, foodstuffs, etc.) in patent drawings according to the Vienna Classification (7th Edition). Intended to guide placement of depicted elements into principal and auxiliary sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Waves (1.15.24)
rubrics_metrics.description: Waves represented as a figurative element.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Not including waves represented by wavy lines (see 26.11.1 to 26.11.3).

rubrics_metrics.name: Other natural phenomena (1.15.25)
rubrics_metrics.description: Natural phenomena not classified in other divisions or categories (example: aurora borealis / northern lights).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used for natural phenomena that do not fit other specific divisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical maps, planispheres (1.17)
rubrics_metrics.description: Planispheres and geographical maps including continents, groups of countries, isolated countries, islands and archipelagoes, parts of a country, urban plans, polar maps, and other geographical maps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Not including maps of the world in two hemispheres (1.5.1). Auxiliary sections: regional subdivisions (A 1.17.3 Europe/Asia/Eurasia; A 1.17.4 America — includes whole of America or any part), A 1.17.5/A 1.17.6 (Africa; Australia, Oceania). Auxiliary sections associated with principal sections 1.17.1–1.17.25 include physical maps (A 1.17.16), political maps (A 1.17.17), economic maps (A 1.17.18), tourist maps (A 1.17.19).

rubrics_metrics.name: Human beings (Category 2)
rubrics_metrics.description: General notes and top-level scope for classifying human-related figurative elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: (a) inscriptions representing a human being are placed in 27.3.1. (b) Heads are placed in appropriate sections of divisions 2.1, 2.3, 2.5 or 2.7, and not in 2.9.25. Subdivisions include men (2.1), women (2.3), children (2.5), mixed groups/scenes (2.7) and parts of the human body (2.9).

rubrics_metrics.name: Men (2.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Depictions of men: heads/busts; armed men or men wearing armour or a uniform; religious figures; men in folk or historical costume; men in suit/dinner jacket; harlequins/clowns/other grotesque figures; acrobats/athletes/dancers/jugglers; musicians; various professions (butchers, chefs, waiters, sailors, peasants, divers, etc.); men mounted on or accompanied by animals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes astronauts. Principal section numeration 2.1.1–2.1.30 lists specific types. Auxiliary sections: shadows/silhouettes (A 2.1.16), men seated/kneeling/lying (A 2.1.17), men drinking/eating (A 2.1.18), men smoking (A 2.1.19), men stylized (A 2.1.23), several men (A 2.1.24), Santa Claus (A 2.1.27), etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Women (2.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Depictions of women: heads/busts; nuns, nurses; women in folk/historical costume; nude women or women in underclothes/bathing costume; women in evening dress; women engaging in sport, dancers, drum majorettes; women wearing kimono/sari/djellaba; city clothes; women cooking or doing housework; women doing agricultural work; women sewing/typing/other professions; allegorical or mythological female personages and other women.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes astronauts. Principal sections 2.3.1–2.3.30 enumerate specifics. Auxiliary sections: heads in silhouette without facial detail (A 2.3.2); women at their toilet/making up (A 2.3.6); women in profile/silhouettes (A 2.3.16); women seated/kneeling/lying (A 2.3.17); women drinking/eating (A 2.3.18); women smoking (A 2.3.19); women stylized (A 2.3.23); several women (A 2.3.24).

rubrics_metrics.name: Children (2.5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Depictions of children: heads/busts, boys, girls, children in folk/historical or cowboy costume, children in working costume or uniform, babies, children engaging in sport or playing, children with musical instruments, children with animals, other children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Not including adolescents (adolescents are classified in divisions 2.1, 2.3 or 2.7). Principal sections 2.5.1–2.5.30 enumerate types. Auxiliary sections include children seated/kneeling/on all fours (A 2.5.17), children drinking/eating (A 2.5.18), children crying (A 2.5.19), pairs of children of different sexes (A 2.5.22), children stylized (A 2.5.23), several children (A 2.5.24), shadows/silhouettes (A 2.5.27).

rubrics_metrics.name: Mixed groups, scenes (2.7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Groups composed of men, women and/or children and scenes: couples; families; group sporting scenes; groups of workers; theatre/variety/concert/dancing scenes; travelling shows, fairs, street scenes; groups eating or drinking; indoor scenes gathered around a table; battle scenes; groups mounted on/with animals; stylized groups; other groups/scenes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: (a) Mixed group means group of men, women and/or children; groups composed only of one sex are placed in 2.1/2.3/2.5. (b) Any group giving impression of a scene is placed in 2.7. Principal sections 2.7.1–2.7.25 enumerate specifics. Auxiliary sections: couple nude or wearing light attire (A 2.7.5).

rubrics_metrics.name: Parts of the human body, skeletons, skulls (2.9)
rubrics_metrics.description: Depictions of human body parts: hearts, eyes (including eyebrows, tears), ears, noses, lips/mouths/tongues, teeth/dentures, hair/wigs/beards/moustaches, hands/fingers/fingernails/hand imprints, arms, fists, feet/toes/imprints, legs, bodies/dummies without head or feet, skeletons/bones (except 2.9.23), skulls, lungs (respiratory system), and other body parts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Heads are not included here but placed in appropriate sections of divisions 2.1, 2.3, 2.5 or 2.7. Auxiliary sections associated with principal sections include open hands (A 2.9.15), hands joined in handshake (A 2.9.16), imprints of hands/fingers (A 2.9.17), thumbs up/thumbs down (A 2.9.20).

rubrics_metrics.name: Animals (Category 3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level notes and subdivisions for animal representations, including quadrupeds (series I–V), quadrumana, parts of bodies/skeletons/skulls of quadrupeds/quadrumana, birds/bats, aquatic animals/scorpions, reptiles/amphibia/snails/seals/sea lions, insects/spiders/micro-organisms, other animals and groups of animals across divisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: (a) Heads of quadrupeds and quadrumana are placed in appropriate sections 3.1–3.5 and not in 3.6.25. (b) Written or typographical matter representing an animal is classified under 27.3.3. Subdivisions 3.1–3.17 enumerate series and special groupings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quadrupeds (Series I) (3.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Animals of Series I (e.g., lions, tigers or other large felines, cats/small felines, dogs/wolves/foxes, bears/koalas/wombats, pandas) and heads of Series I animals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections 3.1.1–3.1.16 list specifics. Auxiliary sections include heraldic lions (A 3.1.2), breed examples (A 3.1.9–A 3.1.11 such as boxers, bulldogs, Saint Bernards, poodles), and many auxiliary descriptors for poses, stylization, costume, standing/lying/sitting (A 3.1.20–A 3.1.28).

rubrics_metrics.name: Quadrupeds (Series II) (3.2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Animals of Series II (e.g., elephants/mammoths, hippopotamus/rhinoceros, giraffes, okapis, camels/dromedaries/llamas/alpacas/vicuñas) and heads of Series II animals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections 3.2.1–3.2.15 list specifics. Auxiliary sections include front-facing or paired elephants (A 3.2.3–A 3.2.4) and auxiliary descriptors for stylized/costumed/standing/lying/sitting (A 3.2.24–A 3.2.28).

rubrics_metrics.name: Quadrupeds (Series III) (3.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Animals of Series III (horses, mules, donkeys, zebras) and heads of Series III animals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections 3.3.1–3.3.15. Auxiliary sections describe rearing, bounding, stylized, costume, standing/lying/sitting poses (A 3.3.17, A 3.3.24–A 3.3.28).

rubrics_metrics.name: Quadrupeds (Series IV) (3.4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Animals of Series IV (bovines, deer/stags/elk/antelopes, goats/sheep, heads of Series IV without horns/with horns, pigs/boars) and related head types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections 3.4.1–3.4.20. Auxiliary sections for specific bovine types (A 3.4.2, A 3.4.4, A 3.4.5) and for stags with/without cross, elk heads (A 3.4.14–A 3.4.16). Additional auxiliaries describe poses and stylization (A 3.4.22–A 3.4.28). Note: heads placed in 3.1–3.5, not 3.6.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quadrupeds (Series V) and Quadrumana (3.5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Series V animals such as rabbits/hares, squirrels, beavers/marmots/badgers, ornithorhynchus, rodents, hedgehogs, pangolins, kangaroos, monkeys/apes/orang-utans and other quadrumana; heads of Series V animals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections 3.5.1–3.5.20 enumerate specifics. Auxiliary sections cover stylized/costumed/standing/lying/sitting (A 3.5.24–A 3.5.28).

rubrics_metrics.name: Parts of quadrupeds or quadrumana; skeletons/skulls (3.6)
rubrics_metrics.description: Parts of the bodies of quadrupeds or quadrumana, skeletons and skulls, including paws/feet/pawprints/footprints, horns, hides/furs/skins, and other body parts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal section 3.6.1 and auxiliaries A 3.6.3, A 3.6.5, A 3.6.6, A 3.6.11, A 3.6.25. Note: does not include heads (placed in 3.1–3.5).

rubrics_metrics.name: Birds and bats (3.7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Bird types and bats including eagles/falcons/vultures, cocks/hens/chickens, turkeys/peacocks, owls, ducks/geese/swans, storks/herons/cranes/flamingos, penguins, albatross/cormorants/gulls/pelicans, swallows, doves/pigeons, jackdaws/crows/rooks/magpies, passerine birds, ostriches/emus, parrots, birds in flight, wings, kiwis (apteryx), heads/parts/feathers/footprints/skeletons, nests and bird cages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections 3.7.1–3.7.26. Notes: (a) Includes wings as symbol/emblem. (b) Excludes certain wing/wheel/stave/helmet symbol cross-references (15.7.17, 24.11.3, 24.11.14). Eggs alone classified in 8.7.11. Auxiliary sections include heraldic eagles (A 3.7.2) and stylized/costumed birds (A 3.7.24–A 3.7.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: Aquatic animals; scorpions (3.9)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fish and fish-like animals (including shark jaws/teeth), heads/parts/fishbones, sea horses, inkfish/octopuses, crustaceans (crabs/shrimps/crayfish/lobsters), starfish, shellfish (oysters, mussels, conches), coral/reef, jellyfish, groups of aquatic animals, aquariums/terrariums/vivariums containing aquatic animals, and other aquatic animals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Not including aquatic animals classified under divisions 3.7, 3.11 or 3.13. Principal sections 3.9.1–3.9.23; auxiliaries list squali (sharks), cetaceans, dolphins, swordfish/narwhal, ornamental fish, flat fish, eels, groups, and stylization/costume (A 3.9.24–A 3.9.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reptiles, amphibia, snails, seals, sea lions (3.11)
rubrics_metrics.description: Serpents, snails/slugs, alligators/caymans/crocodiles, worms, chameleons/lizards/salamanders, tortoises, toads/frogs/tadpoles, seals/sea lions, groups and terrariums/vivariums containing such animals, and other animals of division 3.11.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections 3.11.1–3.11.23. Auxiliary sections include serpent and cup (medical symbol) and serpent(s) and staff (A 3.11.2, A 3.11.3). Stylized and costumed auxiliaries exist (A 3.11.24–A 3.11.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: Insects, spiders, micro-organisms (3.13)
rubrics_metrics.description: Butterflies (3.13.1), other insects, spiders (3.13.2, 3.13.5), beehives/cells of honeycombs, micro-organisms (3.13.20), groups of insects/spiders/micro-organisms (3.13.21).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections detail bees/wasps (A 3.13.4), dragonflies, flies/mosquitoes, spiders/webs, ladybirds, beetles, cockroaches, cicadas/crickets/locusts/grasshoppers, ants, lice/aphids, caterpillars/silkworms, cocoons/chrysalises, and stylized/costumed variants (A 3.13.24–A 3.13.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: Other animals; large prehistoric animals (3.15)
rubrics_metrics.description: Other animal representations and large prehistoric animals not included elsewhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Not including fabulous animals (divisions 4.3 and 4.7). Principal section references contained in category 3.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supernatural, fabulous, fantastic or unidentifiable beings (Category 4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Winged or horned personages, beings partly human/partly animal, fabulous animals, plants/objects/geometrical figures representing personages or animals, masks or fantastic/unidentifiable heads, and groups of figurative elements classified across divisions of category 4.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: Not including human beings and fantastic animals composed of letters/figures (classified in 27.3). Subdivisions include 4.1 (winged or horned personages), 4.2 (partly human/partly animal), 4.3 (fabulous animals), 4.5 (personified plants/objects/geometrical figures/robots), 4.7 (groups across divisions). Examples: cherubs, devils, centaurs, sphinx, tritons, sirens, winged lions/griffons, dragons, Pegasus, unicorns, phoenix, yetis, masks, robots, personified plants/objects, etc. Notes include inclusion of snowmen, scarecrows and ghosts, and cross-references excluding dwarfs and allegorical personages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plants (Category 5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Trees and bushes; leaves/needles/branches; flowers/blossoms; grain/seeds/fruits; vegetables; other plants; decorations made of plants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subdivisions include 5.1 (trees, bushes), 5.3 (leaves, needles, branches), 5.5 (flowers/blossoms), 5.7 (grain/seeds/fruits), 5.9 (vegetables), 5.11 (other plants), 5.13 (decorations of plants). Each principal section enumerates many specific types (e.g., roses, lilies, apples, grapes, bananas, carrots, potatoes, conifers, palm trees, algae, mushrooms, bamboo, cacti, Christmas trees, garlands). Auxiliary sections cover counts (one, two, three, more than three), stylized forms, and exclusions (e.g., repeated-figure backgrounds placed in category 25).

rubrics_metrics.name: Landscapes (Category 6)
rubrics_metrics.description: Landscape types including mountains/rocks/grottoes; landscapes with water/river/stream; desert or tropical-type landscapes; urban landscapes or village scenes; and other landscapes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subdivisions: 6.1 (mountains, rocks, grottoes — includes rock formations, not reefs), 6.3 (lacustrine or maritime scenes; landscapes with running water; auxiliaries for beaches/coasts/islands/open sea/harbors/waterfalls/springs/rivers), 6.6 (desert landscapes, oases, tropical-type landscapes), 6.7 (streets, squares, built-up areas, urban landscapes with water), 6.19 (other landscapes — forest, vineyards, haystacks, grasslands, pastures, polar landscapes, cemeteries, landscapes with windmills/factories/houses). Note: groups of three or more trees placed in tree sections unless representing a forest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Constructions, buildings, advertisement structures (Category 7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Dwellings, buildings, advertisement hoardings or pillars, cages/kennels for animals; parts of dwellings/buildings and interiors; monuments/stadiums/fountains; structural works; building materials, walls/gates/barriers/scaffolding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subdivisions include 7.1 (castles, palaces, churches, mosques, pagodas, towers/masts, houses, skyscrapers, windmills, industrial establishments, filling stations, lighthouses, kiosks, advertisement hoardings, huts, tents, animal cages; stylized or ruins), auxiliaries for rural/flat-roofed/chalet/urban houses and dwellings in ruins; 7.3 (doors, windows, balconies, interiors, roofs, chimneys, shop window displays, staircases, kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, cellars), 7.5 (pyramids, recognized monuments like Eiffel Tower, Great Wall; stadiums; triumphal arches; totem poles; tombstones; fountains/pools), 7.11 (bridges, tunnels, roads, railway lines, mooring posts, hydrants, dams), 7.15 (building materials such as stones/bricks, planks/panels, corrugated iron, wood representations, tiles, walls/gates/barriers, scaffolding). Notes cross-reference exclusions (e.g., Eiffel Tower referenced).

rubrics_metrics.name: Foodstuffs (Category 8)
rubrics_metrics.description: Food categories including bakers' products/pastry/confectionery/chocolate; milk/dairy/cheeses; butchers' meat/pork/fishmongers' products; other foodstuffs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal subdivision 8.1 (bakers' products etc.) listed with sample sections (e.g., 8.1.1, 8.1.6). Further subdivisions for dairy, meat, and other foodstuffs appear in category 8.
